# BridgeTypes
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/chain-bridge/src/libraries/BridgeTypes.sol)

**Title:**
BridgeTypes

Library of types used by the bridge contracts


## Structs
### BridgeOptions
Bridge options structure

This struct is used to pass options to the bridge.

The specifiedAdapter is the address of the adapter to use.

The gasLimit is the gas limit for execution on destination chain.

The calldataSize is the size of expected return calldata (for read operations).

The msgValue is the native value to forward (for operations requiring value).

The options are additional adapter-specific parameters.


```solidity
struct BridgeOptions {
    address specifiedAdapter; // Required specific adapter to use (address(0) will revert)
    uint64 gasLimit; // Gas limit for execution on destination chain
    uint32 calldataSize; // Size of expected return calldata (for read operations)
    uint128 msgValue; // Native value to forward (for operations requiring value)
    bytes options; // Additional adapter-specific parameters
}
```

### ExecuteTransferParams
Parameters for executeTransferAssets

This struct is used to transfer assets from one chain to another.

The originator is the address that initiated the transfer ie. crosschain ark

The target is the address that will receive the assets.

The asset is the address of the asset to be transferred.

The amount is the amount of the asset to be transferred.

The message is the message to be sent to the destination chain.

The refundAddress is the address that will receive the refund.


```solidity
struct ExecuteTransferParams {
    address originator;
    uint16 destinationChainId;
    address target;
    address asset;
    uint256 amount;
    bytes message;
    address refundAddress;
}
```

### ExecuteReadStateParams
Parameters for executeReadState

This struct is used to read state from a contract on a destination chain.

The originator is the address that initiated the read state operation ie. crosschain ark

The destinationChainId is the chain id of the destination chain.

The target is the address that will be read from.

The selector is the selector of the function to read state from.

The readParams are the parameters to pass to the read state function.

The refundAddress is the address that will receive the refund.


```solidity
struct ExecuteReadStateParams {
    address originator;
    uint16 destinationChainId;
    address target;
    bytes4 selector;
    bytes readParams;
    address refundAddress;
}
```

### ExecuteSendMessageParams
Parameters for executeSendMessage

This struct is used to send a message to a destination chain.

The originator is the address that initiated the send message operation ie. crosschain ark

The destinationChainId is the chain id of the destination chain.

The target is the address that will receive the message.

The message is the message to be sent to the destination chain.

The refundAddress is the address that will receive the refund.


```solidity
struct ExecuteSendMessageParams {
    address originator;
    uint16 destinationChainId;
    address target;
    bytes message;
    address refundAddress;
}
```

### RelayedReadResponse
Generic wrapper for a cross-chain state–read response

Keeps result bytes in a typed container so every contract
that consumes the response can simply:
BridgeTypes.ReadResponse memory r =
abi.decode(resultData, (BridgeTypes.ReadResponse));
and then decode `r.data` to whatever concrete type it expects.


```solidity
struct RelayedReadResponse {
    bytes readResponseData; // ABI-encoded return data of the read call
    bytes32 operationId;
    uint16 sourceChainId;
}
```

## Enums
### OperationStatus
Status of a cross-chain transfer


```solidity
enum OperationStatus {
    SENT, // Operation has been sent to the destination chain
    FAILED // Operation has failed
}
```

### OperationType

```solidity
enum OperationType {
    MESSAGE,
    READ_STATE,
    TRANSFER_ASSET
}
```
